scientific_question: Do self-sustaining limit cycle oscillations and ordered phase sequences emerge from cat anatomy?
method: Forward Euler leaky rate dynamics + SVD/PCA

method: Spatiotemporal binning (30 slices x t) & cross-correlation

scientific_question: Can stride frequency and burst amplitude be independently modulated via cell-type-specific gains in cat circuits?

scientific_question: Does the observed computational behavior depend specifically on Yakovenko spatial organization and E/I balance?
